CITY OF BURBANK
  SUSTAINABLE BURBANK COMMISSION
  Community Services Building
  Room 104
  150 N. Third St.,
  Burbank, California 91502

  June 15, 2026
  5:00 P.M.
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that a regular meeting of the Sustainable Burbank Commission will be held
on Monday, June 15, 2026, at 5:00 p.m., at the Community Services Building located at 150 N Third Street
to discuss matters on the attached agenda.

This agenda lists each item of business that the Sustainable Burbank Commission (SBC) may discuss or
take action on at this meeting. Copies of staff reports and all other written documentation relating to each
agenda item can be made available by calling (818) 238-3800. Copies are available for public inspection
and review at the Public Works Yard located at 124 S. Lake Street.

This facility is disabled accessible. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), if any
special assistance is needed to participate in this meeting, please contact the City’s ADA Coordinator at
(818) 238-5051 (voice) or (818) 238-5035 TDD. Advance notification of 48 hours will permit the City to
make reasonable accommodations to ensure accessibility.

Interpretation Requests:
If you would like to participate in Public Comments and require an interpreter, please telephone the City
Clerk’s Office at (818) 238-5851 at least 48 hours in advance of the meeting.

Si desea participar en los comentarios públicos y necesita un intérprete, por favor llame a la Oficina de la
Secretaria Municipal al (818) 238-5851 al menos 48 horas antes de la reunión.

Public Comment: To speak during the Public Comment period, members of the public may:

  1. Speak for three minutes in-person at the Community Services Building, Room 104, or,
  2. Request a Zoom link from srosales@burbankca.gov by noon the day of the meeting (note, the link
  is for public comment only, the meeting will not be broadcast)
  a. Once the request is received, the speaker will be emailed a Zoom link and instructions prior
  to the start of the meeting.

  Members of the public that attend the meeting will speak first. Public speakers waiting in the Zoom
  webinar link will speak once in-person attendees have completed speaking.

  GREEN SPOTLIGHT AWARD
  NOMINATION FORM
  Sustainable Burbank Commission I City of Burbank

The Green Spotlight Award recognizes local businesses, organizations, and
residents for outstanding achievements in sustainable economic development and
environmental preservation. It aims to promote, encourage, and inspire sustainable
practices that support a healthy economy and environment.

CRITERIA FOR NOMINATION
  -  Demonstrates exceptional, above-and-beyond practices that positively impact the City and/or
  its residents
  -  Resides or is located within the City
  -  Complies with all local, state, and federal laws and regulations

SELECTION PROCESS
Nominations will be evaluated and voted on by Sustainable Burbank Commissioners.

HONOREE PRESENTATION PROCESS
Recognition and a certificate will be presented during the monthly SBC meeting.

Burbank Eco Council members Melissa Thompson and Karen Lau truly went above
and beyond in making this year’s Burbank Earth Day event the great success that it
was. Melissa volunteered over 155 hours of project management time, which included
creating and managing the event planning schedule, vendor recruitment and
coordination, securing entertainment and speakers, creating the event map — you
name it, she was involved in it. Karen played a pivotal role as well, providing invaluable
support and guidance along the way. Their hard work and dedication to the event as
well as their commitment to sustainability in Burbank deserves our recognition and
deepest gratitude.
